repairs.old:
(Lp.coeFn_add F G)] with z hfg hf hg hadd hFG
    simpa [hfg, hf, hg, hadd, hFG]
repairs.new:
(Lp.coeFn_add F G)] with z hfg hf hg hadd hFG
    calc
      _ = ↑↑(F + G) (z : ℂ) := hfg
      _ = ((↑↑F + ↑↑G) ∘ fun z : ℍ => (z : ℂ)) z := hFG
      _ = (↑↑((ambientPlane_comp_upper_memLp F).toLp
            (fun z : ℍ ↦ F (z : ℂ))) +
          ↑↑((ambientPlane_comp_upper_memLp G).toLp
            (fun z : ℍ ↦ G (z : ℂ)))) z := by
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.add_apply, hf, hg]
      _ = _ := hadd.symm
repairs.evidence: The five a.e. equalities are sufficient, but simp rewrites them in unstable directions. The calc fixes the intended path from toLp(F+G), through pointwise F+G, to the Lp addition coercion.
repairs.probe_risk: Coercion display of the two toLp values may require a smaller change or explicit parentheses after elaboration.

repairs.old:

    simpa [hcf, hf, hc]
repairs.new:
(Lp.coeFn_smul c F)] with z hcf hf hc
    calc
      _ = ↑↑(c • F) (z : ℂ) := hcf
      _ = ((c • ↑↑F) ∘ fun z : ℍ => (z : ℂ)) z := hc
      _ = c * ↑↑((ambientPlane_comp_upper_memLp F).toLp
          (fun z : ℍ ↦ F (z : ℂ))) z := by
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hf]
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [Lp.coeFn_smul, smul_eq_mul]
repairs.evidence: This is the scalar counterpart of S02 and uses hcf, hc and hf in a fixed direction instead of asking simp to discover the chain.
repairs.probe_risk: The final Lp.coeFn_smul lemma may simplify only a.e. rather than pointwise in this elaborated context; direct replay is required.
